comment: The waveform is a sample counter raised to the exponent, divided by itself plus one, and mapped to a voltage (fraction.cpp:82 to :86). The first output is scaled by 2 and offset by -1 before a gain of 5; the second by 2 and offset by -0.5 before a gain of 10, which is why the two are not a matched pair. The octave knob is a snapping knob, so it moves in whole octaves. The counter resets when it reaches the sample rate divided by the frequency, rounded down (fraction.cpp:75 to :80).
